turns.report: Read messages.py which defines sanitize(messages) that copies each message dict, removes keys id, output, model, meta if present, and returns list of cleaned dicts. The function does not preserve the original dict order or identity but it preserves content values (i.e., keeps all other keys and their values unchanged). Therefore removed_fields are sorted ['id','model','meta','output']; preserves_original (preserves original dict) is false because a new dict is created; preserves_content (preserves content values) is true because all non-removed keys retain their original values. Created answer.json with these values. Created candidate_tests.py with simple assertions checking removal and content preservation. Ran tests via run_tests and they passed successfully. No modifications to messages.py were made.
